title: Orange Zest Bread Pudding
description: A traditional German bread pudding infused with the brightness of orange zest, perfect as a dessert.

ingredients.name: bread, stale
ingredients.notes: any type of bread works, but a dense bread like challah or brioche is best

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: whole milk or a non-dairy milk alternative

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the orange juice, sugar, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the milk, vanilla extract, and whisk until well combined.
Add the bread cubes and toss until the bread is evenly coated with the wet ingredients.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the bread mixture sit for 10-15 minutes.
After the bread has sat for 10-15 minutes, add the orange zest and pudding.
Mix until the bread and pudding are evenly distributed.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the pudding is set.
Remove the bread pudding from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with additional orange zest if desired.
